rule: A2O batch 3 is the fixed benchmark test; all other already inspected or method-development cohorts are development data. The historical held-out label in a cohort name describes the original paper run, not a new untouched benchmark test.
exposure: These benchmark splits were fixed after the first paper outcomes existed. The original A2O batch 3 locator was frozen before its blind run, but its published results are now visible. Do not describe future tuning against public test results as a new blinded evaluation.
grouping: Use whole source cohorts and recorder/site/deployment groups, not random clips from a shared deployment. The A2O batch 3 test split ships the blind runs' own squares per recording (data/b3_blind_squares.csv).
